messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
tekka_centre | Tekka Centre | 8 | 45 | 06:30-21:00 | -
orchard_road | Orchard Road | 0 | 120 | 10:00-22:00 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -
cable_car | Singapore Cable Car | 35 | 45 | 08:45-22:00 | -
skypark | Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck | 32 | 60 | 11:00-21:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
wings_of_time | Wings of Time | 19 | 20 | 19:30-21:30 | 19:40, 20:40
maxwell | Maxwell Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 08:00-24:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
peranakan_museum: tekka_centre 14, orchard_road 16, singapore_flyer 15, cable_car 21, skypark 15, national_gallery 12, wings_of_time 25, maxwell 14
tekka_centre: peranakan_museum 14, orchard_road 16, singapore_flyer 16, cable_car 23, skypark 17, national_gallery 15, wings_of_time 28, maxwell 18
orchard_road: peranakan_museum 16, tekka_centre 16, singapore_flyer 20, cable_car 20, skypark 20, national_gallery 17, wings_of_time 25, maxwell 18
singapore_flyer: peranakan_museum 15, tekka_centre 16, orchard_road 20, cable_car 23, skypark 12, national_gallery 14, wings_of_time 26, maxwell 16
cable_car: peranakan_museum 21, tekka_centre 23, orchard_road 20, singapore_flyer 23, skypark 22, national_gallery 21, wings_of_time 16, maxwell 18
skypark: peranakan_museum 15, tekka_centre 17, orchard_road 20, singapore_flyer 12, cable_car 22, national_gallery 14, wings_of_time 25, maxwell 15
national_gallery: peranakan_museum 12, tekka_centre 15, orchard_road 17, singapore_flyer 14, cable_car 21, skypark 14, wings_of_time 24, maxwell 14
wings_of_time: peranakan_museum 25, tekka_centre 28, orchard_road 25, singapore_flyer 26, cable_car 16, skypark 25, national_gallery 24, maxwell 21
maxwell: peranakan_museum 14, tekka_centre 18, orchard_road 18, singapore_flyer 16, cable_car 18, skypark 15, national_gallery 14, wings_of_time 21

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

My day out runs from 11:00 until 20:30. Money is not a concern. I definitely need to see Peranakan Museum, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck and National Gallery Singapore. If there's time, I'd also like Tekka Centre, Orchard Road, Singapore Flyer, Singapore Cable Car, Wings of Time and Maxwell Food Centre. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Maxwell Food Centre.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Places data: id, cost, duration, open_start, open_end, showtimes
places = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"name": "Peranakan Museum", "cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "tekka_centre": {"name": "Tekka Centre", "cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 390, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "orchard_road": {"name": "Orchard Road", "cost": 0, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "singapore_flyer": {"name": "Singapore Flyer", "cost": 40, "dur": 45, "open": 600, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "cable_car": {"name": "Singapore Cable Car", "cost": 35, "dur": 45, "open": 525, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "skypark": {"name": "Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck", "cost": 32, "dur": 60, "open": 660, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "national_gallery": {"name": "National Gallery Singapore", "cost": 25, "dur": 150, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "wings_of_time": {"name": "Wings of Time", "cost": 19, "dur": 20, "open": 1170, "close": 1290, "shows": [1180, 1240]},
    "maxwell": {"name": "Maxwell Food Centre", "cost": 8, "dur": 30, "open": 480, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
}

travel_times = {
    "peranakan_museum": {"peranakan_museum": 0, "tekka_centre": 14, "orchard_road": 16, "singapore_flyer": 15, "cable_car": 21, "skypark": 15, "national_gallery": 12, "wings_of_time": 25, "maxwell": 14},
    "tekka_centre": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "tekka_centre": 0, "orchard_road": 16, "singapore_flyer": 16, "cable_car": 23, "skypark": 17, "national_gallery": 15, "wings_of_time": 28, "maxwell": 18},
    "orchard_road": {"peranakan_museum": 16, "tekka_centre": 16, "orchard_road": 0, "singapore_flyer": 20, "cable_car": 20, "skypark": 20, "national_gallery": 17, "wings_of_time": 25, "maxwell": 18},
    "singapore_flyer": {"peranakan_museum": 15, "tekka_centre": 16, "orchard_road": 20, "cable_car": 23, "skypark": 12, "national_gallery": 14, "wings_of_time": 26, "maxwell": 16},
    "cable_car": {"peranakan_museum": 21, "tekka_centre": 23, "orchard_road": 20, "singapore_flyer": 23, "skypark": 22, "national_gallery": 21, "wings_of_time": 16, "maxwell": 18},
    "skypark": {"peranakan_museum": 15, "tekka_centre": 17, "orchard_road": 20, "singapore_flyer": 12, "cable_car": 22, "national_gallery": 14, "wings_of_time": 25, "maxwell": 15},
    "national_gallery": {"peranakan_museum": 12, "tekka_centre": 15, "orchard_road": 17, "singapore_flyer": 14, "cable_car": 21, "skypark": 14, "wings_of_time": 24, "maxwell": 14},
    "wings_of_time": {"peranakan_museum": 25, "tekka_centre": 28, "orchard_road": 25, "singapore_flyer": 26, "cable_car": 16, "skypark": 25, "national_gallery": 24, "maxwell": 21},
    "maxwell": {"peranakan_museum": 14, "tekka_centre": 18, "orchard_road": 18, "singapore_flyer": 16, "cable_car": 18, "skypark": 15, "national_gallery": 14, "wings_of_time": 21, "maxwell": 0}
}

day_start = 660  # 11:00
day_end = 1230   # 20:30

must_visit = ["peranakan_museum", "skypark", "national_gallery"]
all_places = list(places.keys())

opt = Optimize()

visit = {p: Bool(f"visit_{p}") for p in all_places}
start = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in all_places}
end = {p: Int(f"end_{p}") for p in all_places}

# Must visit constraints
for p in must_visit:
    opt.add(visit[p])

for p in all_places:
    p_info = places[p]
    dur = p_info["dur"]
    
    # Time bounds and duration
    opt.add(start[p] >= day_start)
    opt.add(end[p] <= day_end)
    opt.add(end[p] == start[p] + dur)
    
    # Opening hours
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], start[p] >= p_info["open"]))
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], end[p] <= p_info["close"]))
    
    # Showtimes if applicable
    if p_info["shows"]:
        show_constraints = Or([start[p] == st for st in p_info["shows"]])
        opt.add(Implies(visit[p], show_constraints))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints
for i, p1 in enumerate(all_places):
    for j, p2 in enumerate(all_places):
        if i != j:
            t_time = travel_times[p1][p2]
            # If both visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2.start OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1.start
            opt.add(Implies(
                And(visit[p1], visit[p2]),
                Or(end[p1] + t_time <= start[p2], end[p2] + t_time <= start[p1])
            ))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    result = []
    for p in all_places:
        if is_true(m.eval(visit[p])):
            s_val = m.eval(start[p]).as_long()
            e_val = m.eval(end[p]).as_long()
            result.append({"location_id": p, "start": s_val, "end": e_val})
    
    # Sort by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
